Rhea Chakraborty Considered 'Chudail Ka Badla' for Brand Name

Actress Rhea Chakraborty reportedly considered naming her brand 'Chudail Ka Badla' (Witch's Revenge). She stated that she felt like a 'chudail' (witch) and was not receiving film offers. This decision to consider such a name for her brand reflects her personal feelings and professional challenges at the time.
